verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no SigNoz policy, setting, or contractual commitment about whether customer data is used to train AI models. The only related item is the self-hosting option, which keeps 'full control of your data plane' (signoz-gh-1). That is an adjacent deployment choice, not a documented training opt-out, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
